evidence: Corpus facts measured 2026-08-26 (AFLDB-ISSUE-093-DRAFTGURU-INVESTIGATION-HANDOFF.md sections 1-2): 42 files, 6,810 rows, years 1981/1982/1986-2025; the browser export preserved rendered text only, so two same-name people (e.g. both 2001 Brad Millers) are indistinguishable in this artifact while the live annual HTML distinguishes them by href ordinal.
